scope: Complete immediate comparison and broad-answer-label families: young plants versus buds, seedling raising versus general raising/cultivation, lake/river shores, paddy paths and whole fields. Existing articles are read separately rather than assumed to match all family senses.
limits: Candidate navigation is not a semantic audit; no frequency inference from missing priorities. No duplicate support for alternate 苗字, no component reading invented for the older 田畝 spellings.
